title: Anastasis Childerici I. Francorum regis, sive thesaurus sepulchralis Tornaci Nerviorum effossus et commentario illustratus
bibliographicNote: Antwerp, Officina Plantiniana Balthasaris Moreti. Digitised volume R6A.0608 in Namur. Olivier Latteur’s accompanying French catalogue essay (January 2025) sets out the circumstances of the discovery and the author’s position at the Habsburg court. The rights fields for this digitisation state PublicDomain and OpenAccess.
